document.cue: Describe a subject you enjoyed studying at school.

text: I'd like to talk about history, which was my favourite subject at school. I studied it from the fifth grade until I finished school, and it was taught by Mr Serik, a teacher who had a very good sense of humour. Although many of my classmates thought it was boring, I always looked forward to his lessons.

In class we learned about ancient civilisations, the Silk Road and the history of Kazakhstan in the twentieth century. Instead of just reading the textbook, Mr Serik told us stories about real people, so it felt like watching a film. Sometimes we divided into groups and acted out historical events, and once I played a medieval merchant, which was great fun. For homework we had to prepare short presentations, and I learned how to find information in different sources and decide which ones were reliable. That skill has been very useful for my university essays as well.

I enjoyed this subject because it helped me understand why the world is the way it is today. When you know what happened in the past, current news becomes much easier to understand. Also, I'm quite curious by nature, so I liked discovering unusual facts that nobody mentions in everyday life. I think the teacher played a big part, because he made us ask questions instead of only memorising dates. Even now I sometimes watch documentaries or visit museums just for pleasure.
